_comment_template: The template family fitted to the environmental injection. 'pn' = SuperKludge 0PA with the 2.5PN flux deviation switched on; 'vacuum' = the same waveform class as the signal, disk dropped.
_comment_injection: The environmentally perturbed source, matching test.ipynb cells 2-4 (set 5: p0 = 24.35, e0 = 0.2, Sigma0 = 5.25e5 g/cm^2, h0 = 0.025). All 14 waveform parameters; anything not listed in 'infer' stays pinned here for the template too.
_comment_disk: Accretion disk the injection is evolved through. Sigma0 is given in g/cm^2 and converted to geometric units from m1 at load time. The template never sees these.
_comment_infer: The intrinsic fit vector. The template's own extra parameters (dev_1, dev_2 for 'pn') are appended automatically. 'a' is deliberately absent: it is held at its injected 0.0.
_comment_pn: chi2_secondary is an ASSUMPTION: the secondary spin was never supplied for this source. evolve_1PA is False because the injection is adiabatic + disk, so the template baseline must be 0PA too.
_comment_waveform: T in years, or null to run to plunge times T_safety. The plunge time always comes from the environmental trajectory, so signal and template share one T.
_comment_bounds: +-sigma_range Fisher sigma about the injection, clipped to what the waveform can take. The parameters in 'full_period' instead span one whole period [inj - pi, inj + pi]: they are periodic, so this adds reach, not physics. It is needed because the notebook's vacuum LM fit put Phi_phi0 at +26 sigma, outside any 5-sigma box. dev_1/dev_2 are capped at +-100 as a guard against a flat-direction sigma.
_comment_de: Passed straight to scipy.optimize.differential_evolution, bar report_every.
_comment_lm: House CV controls, identical to every script under src/{EMRI,IMRI}.
_comment_nm: DE has already done the global search, so the Nelder-Mead escape is off here. It is on in the from-0PA run, where the seed sits on the flat deviation ridge.
_comment_output: Relative paths resolve next to this config file.
